notes.title: 1.0.5 - The 'First Class' Update is here!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Major Update! [/h2][/b]
Hey everyone! we’re excited to announce [b]The First Class Update[/b] is now live! This major quality-of-life update adds additional polish and some final touches, based on player feedback we've received since launch!

To celebrate, we’re offering our [i]deepest discount yet[/i]. From 2nd - 9th June, [b]Loco Motive is 20% off![/b] 
Tell your friends, your heirs, and any sworn adversaries!

There’s never been a better time to play, so climb aboard! You’ll be playing the most refined version of Loco Motive to date, complete with extra polish and optimisations designed to enhance your experience.

You can find a full rundown of the patch notes below, but here's a brief overview:

[h3]Update Overview[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Refined puzzle logic[/b], for smoother gameplay across key chapters
[*] [b]Improvements to UI[/b], such as mouse wheel scrolling in the inventory!
[*] [b]Numerous bugs squashed[/b], enhancing overall stability and player experience
[*] [b]Additional polish[/b], to animations, environment visuals, and more!
[*] [b]English (US) localisation introduced[/b], alongside the existing English (UK) version
[*] [b]Overhauled Autosave system[/b], improving performance and reliability
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/d08f1cb466e983a35fd85f4dbb6e03f0d1c722dd.png[/img]

[h3]MCV/Develop Awards [/h3]

Great news, folks! We’ve been shortlisted for [b]Visual Innovation of the Year[/b] in the upcoming[url=https://mcvdevelopawards.com/] [b]2025 MCV/DEVELOP Awards[/b][/url], taking place in London, UK on June 19, 2025. 

The [b]MCV/DEVELOP Awards[/b] have been around for over 20 years, and aim to recognise the successes of the UK games industry in every area that it excels. We worked on Loco Motive for close to four years, so it’s immensely cool to be recognised by our peers, and to be nominated alongside some incredible titles. Fingers crossed and best of luck to everybody!

You can check out the [url=https://mcvuk.com/business-news/this-is-the-shortlist-for-the-2025-mcv-develop-awards/]full shortlist here.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/c3a7ed0caa65576f3ef37f34e2ce0165b61b5c6f.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Milestone Reached![/h3]

We've crunched the numbers and we're so excited to share that Loco Motive has now sold over [b]30,000 copies[/b] across [b]PC and Nintendo Switch[/b]. This is a huge milestone for a small team like ours, especially with our debut title. It truly means the world to us. If you played Loco Motive at launch, told a friend about us, or even spread the word on socials, then we couldn’t have reached this point without you! [b]Thank you so much for your continued feedback, passion, and support![/b]

[b]Without further ado, here’s the spoiler-free nitty gritty of this update…[/b]

[h3]1.0.5 - Full Patch Notes[/h3]

[expand type=details expanded=false]1.0.5 - Full Patch Notes

[h3]Puzzle Tweaks[/h3]

[b][i]Publisher Office[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Herman now keeps the packing popcorn item after one use
[*] Added interaction when using popcorn on the board input slot
[*] Herman can now use the popcorn directly and indirectly to solve the puzzle.
[*] Herman now automatically collects the item after examining the waste basket
[/list]
[b][i]The Mansion[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Changed visuals for boiler flames to embers for better puzzle clarity
[*] Adjusted tooltip for an item in the mansion basement for puzzle clarity
[/list]
[b][i]The Order Of Idle Hands[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Using the correct item on Mr Masson will now automatically trigger the vote sequence
[*] Expanded the viable locations where Herman can locate the idol engraving clue
[*] Arthur now automatically reads the clue from ‘Dr Phogg’s Guide To Invis-Ability’ after obtaining it
[*] Changed Rosebud behaviour so Arthur drinks it automatically after obtaining it
[/list]
[b][i]Lady Unterwald Quarters[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Expanded the viable items that work when used on Mr Liu's clenched fist
[*] Added fade out before Arthur learns the handshake ‘call and response’ for the first time
[/list]
[b][i]The Green Room[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Expanded the viable items that can solve the 'Knifey, Stab, Stab' puzzle.
[/list]
[b][i]Engine Room[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Diana can now use the serum directly and indirectly during the engine room encounter
[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added mouse wheel scrolling functionality for the inventory
[*] Added Autosave disclaimer screen on start-up
[*] Added UI for when the player attempts an input that is blocked by the game state
[*] Updated the loading screen indicator to a spinning icon
[*] Updated inventory scrolling label text and translations
[*] Fixed inventory sprites and item grid being misaligned
[*] Enabled inventory UI arrow indicators when using a gamepad
[*] Improved clarity of scrolling arrow indicators on the inventory UI
[/list]
[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed inventory closing during specific item interactions
[*] Fixed the valve in not being connected to the wall pipe in Part Six
[*] Fixed visual sorting issues with Diana and Philately Stamp in the test yard
[*] Fixed issues with the band card game background sequence waiting and idle states
[*] Fixed the card game background sequence state not resetting fully when it is started
[*] Fixed the background sequence state not resetting fully when loading a save in the green room
[*] Fix for existing saves affected by Arista disappearing after repairing her item
[*] Fixed Arista not being visible in the lounge after repairing her item
[*] Fixed item not being removed after successfully winning the knife game
[*] Fixed various text inconsistencies and issues
[*] Fixed Arthur commenting that an item won't open the drawer when the drawer is already open
[*] Fixed Herman being able to learn the band name without stealing the corresponding item
[*] Fixed vote cutscene being re-triggered when reusing an item after solving the puzzle
[*] Fixed Hirsch facing away during a cutscene in Part Four
[*] Fixed waiter kitchen dialogue triggering before drinking the Rosebud
[*] Fixed missing animation trigger on Arthur's use item chest animations
[*] Fixed waiter kitchen dialogue triggering before receiving the necessary item
[*] Fixed Herman rendering underneath the rug during a cutscene in Part Four
[*] Fixed typo on Publisher Frank dialogue tree option
[*] Fixed sorting layer issues when April and Diana leave the test yard
[*] Fixed the fuel canister being incorrectly marked as empty during Part Five
[*] Fixed Pierre blocking the shoeshine chair prop behind him in Part Three
[*] Fixed sunset background tree sprite sorting order in multiple carriages
[*] Fixed Herman not resetting properly if you use another character to solve the puzzle during the finale
[*] Fixed Herman facing the wrong direction after the twins stare at him in the lobby
[*] Fixed Noir mode being disabled if it was active at the start of Part Four
[*] Fixed twins idle animations erroneously playing if you interact with Hagen
[*] Fixed incorrectly set flag for the drawer in Lady Unterwald's room
[*] Fixed being able to repeatedly use an item on the papers in the engine room
[*] Fixed animation markers being in the wrong place for one of Diana's ‘pick up’ animations
[*] Fixed Diana not walking to the button when interacting with it in the test yard
[*] Fixed Brother Jared not resetting properly when entering the room beyond the curtain
[*] Fixed rendering issues when Herman wakes up in the room beyond the curtain
[*] Fixed duplication of an item when leaving the test yard
[*] Fixed issues with selecting the outside window hotspot on a gamepad during Part Six
[*] Fixed player walking over the oyster bag in the kitchen carriage when it is visible
[*] Fixed Arthur rendering issues when using an item on the locker during Part Six
[*] Fixed selected inventory items remaining active when combining them and using a game-pad
[*] Fixed navigation prompts remaining active when look at or combining items using a game-pad
[*] Fixed sunset environment sprites import settings being set incorrectly
[*] Fixed the environment being night if you go out on to the rooftop access in Part Three
[*] Added timeouts to various background animations to prevent potential soft-locks
[/list]
[h3][b]Misc[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added English [US] localisation
[*] Updated English [UK] localisation
[*] Added missing Mr. Masson idle animation during Part Six
[*] Added missing animations when picking up a certain item in the test yard
[*] Added missing animations when interacting with the pneumatic station in the test yard
[*] Updated train environment animations in Part Six
[*] Updated chapter four introduction cutscene timings
[*] Removed unnecessary off-screen line during the finale
[*] Imported updated version of Arthur device closeup sprites
[*] Increased Diana’s walk speed in the test yard, but disabled sprinting for this area. 
[*] Added reading animation when Arthur obtains a specific item from the briefcase
[*] Updated localisation for STOVE platform
[/list]
[h3][b]Save System[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The autosave system has been overhauled to enhance stability.
[*] Saving is improved with smaller file sizes and faster processing times.
[*] To prevent accidental data overwriting, a one-minute autosave grace period will now trigger after loading a save state
[/list]
[/expand] 

That's all for now! If you want to chat to us directly, join our community discussion[url=discord.gg/locomotive] on Discord![/url] - We can also be [url=https://bsky.app/profile/robustgames.bsky.social]reached via Bluesky[/url] if that's more your speed! 

Let us know what you think!

[i]- Robust Games[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1709880/Loco_Motive/

notes.title: The Road Ahead!
notes.content:
[h3]Happy New Year! [/h3]

After a short post launch break over the holidays, we jumped back into things last week and are now looking towards our next major update for Loco Motive.

1.0.4 was successful in addressing the majority of issues reported by our community after launch, but we still have a few sneaky lingering bugs to investigate. Our first priority will be to fix remaining issues and continue to improve the player experience.

In the new year we were humbled to recieve the [url=https://adventuregamehotspot.com/feature/3332/the-hotspot-highlights-the-best-adventure-games-of-2024][i]Adventure Game Of The Year[/i][/url] award from [b]The Adventure Game Hotspot[/b], and to have received [url=https://x.com/LocoMotiveGame/status/1876715810187571541][i]six nominations[/i][/url] in the upcoming [b]AGOTY Awards[/b], 

We deeply appreciate all of the feedback and support we’ve received so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/d509e68c9cbf32c640bb79005ee534cbd8ce8157.png[/img]

[h3]Quality Of Life Update[/h3]

Outside of bug squashing, we’re working towards a bigger Quality of Life Update which will take into account the community feedback we’ve received post launch.

This update will include:
[list]
[*] UI fixes
[*] Minor puzzle enhancements
[*] New Features
[*] Reworked Autosave for a better experience with save games. 
[/list]
That’s not an exhaustive list, but we’ll be sharing more details in an upcoming dev blog!

[h3]500![/h3]

We’re also fast approaching 500 reviews on Steam! User reviews have been important in helping other players decide whether to play Loco Motive, and we’re very grateful to everyone who has taken the time to leave a review so far!

If you want to chat to us directly about the game, [url=discord.gg/locomotive]come join our community discussion over on Discord![/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1709880/Loco_Motive/

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 is OUT!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We really appreciate your passion and support since the launch—it means a lot to us. Patch 1.0.4 is now live on PC and Nintendo Switch* - This is our first update, and it addresses many of the bugs and issues you've reported since release. 

[i]*(17/12/2024) The patch is now available on Nintendo Switch, thank you for your patience![/i]

Thanks to all of your helpful feedback and reports, we believe we’ve pinpointed the cause of the soft-locking issues. These should now be resolved, and we can’t thank you enough for your patience while we worked on these fixes!

Here’s a rundown of the changes:

[b][STABILITY][/b]

[list]
[*] fixed soft locks caused by incorrect handling of cancelled interactions
[*] fixed soft lock that could occur when clicking multiple times on don's broken door
[*] fixed rare soft lock when interacting with sister Gretchen and brother Jared in chapter two
[*] fixed soft lock where the band could get stuck in a loop when entering green room in chapter four
[*] fixed threading issue that could occur when interacting with the band members
[*] fixed soft lock that could occur when rapidly clicking on the casino patrons
[*] fixed potential threading issues when showing the perfumed note to characters
[*] fixed threading issue when talking to the highrollers in the casino
[*] fixed potential threading issues when leaving dialogue trees
[*] fixed soft lock due to erroneous character positioning during chapter six
[*] fixed threading issues when interacting with characters whilst drunk
[*] fixed a crash on certain windows system languages when looking at the medical records
[*] fixed null reference exception when an active controller is disconnected due to low battery
[*] fixed background sequences being stopped when an interaction is cancelled
[*] fixed soft lock when loading into chapter six from an autosave
[*] fixed a soft lock when talking to the chefs in chapter three
[*] fixed threading issues during unhandled fall-back interactions with characters, inventory items & props
[*] fixed soft lock when giving the briefcase to the twins in chapter two
[/list]
[b][DIALOGUE][/b]
[list]
[*] fixed german eszett character not appearing for lines displayed in all caps
[*] fixed dialogue text rendering off screen when using certain settings
[*] fixed issue where Lady Unterwald displayed incorrect dialogue options at beginning of chapter four
[*] fixed subtitle dialogue continuing to show after the twins escape from the vent in chapter four
[*] fixed accessibility text settings not being applied to background sequence dialogue
[/list]
[b][VISUAL][/b]
[list]
[*] fixed doctor Hirsch being very shy and facing the wall during handshake cutscenes in chapter four
[*] fixed Diana rendering underneath the motorbike in the test yard
[*] fixed Don remaining invisible if you leave the casino without following him
[*] fixed visual bug when showing Ron the detective badge at the dining table
[*] fixed the quartermaster from disappearing when using the hint line in the test yard
[*] fixed issue where Herman could show the detective badge to characters while in disguise
[*] fixed visual issues when giving the briefcase to the twins in chapter two
[*] fixed visual issues when giving the sketches to doctor Hirsch in chapter two
[*] fixed Philately Stamp visual issues during the mansion lobby cutscene in the finale 
[*] fixed issue where Don appeared in the post credits cutscene
[/list]
[b][GAMEPLAY][/b]
[list]
[*] added specific calls for combining the various knife state items with the slippery mixture
[*] fixed Arthur not walking towards brother Jared when interacting whilst drunk
[*] fixed Arthur not walking towards Belle when giving her an item
[*] fixed suction boots remaining active when using them on the ladder in chapter four
[*] fixed incendiary pencils remaining active when using them on the firebox in chapter five
[*] fixed hearing horn background sequence continuing when leaving the room
[*] fixed Don's betting sequence being triggered if you enter the casino whilst he's leaving for the dining carriage
[*] fixed Don and Bergmann background sequence continuing when leaving the room
[*] fixed publisher pigeon background sequence continuing when looking at the in-tray
[/list]
[b][SAVES][/b]
[list]
[*] fix for save states affected by erroneous character positioning in chapter six
[*] fixed handshake club lights issue on initial autosave after Arthur drinks the rosebud
[*] fixed autosave icon not disappearing if an action was cancelled by the player
[/list]
[b][UI][/b]
[list]
[*] updated credits list
[*] fixed the console being accessible on release builds
[*] fixed tutorial popups not disappearing if an action was cancelled by the player
[/list]

We encourage you to keep sharing your feedback and thoughts on forums and social media. We’re actively reading your comments and taking note of areas where we can improve in future updates. If you come across any more issues, please report them! This helps us investigate your specific case and implement fixes more quickly.

Thank you so much for your continued feedback, passion, and support during this time!

notes.title: Development Update #13
notes.content:
🎊[b][u]Loco Motive is finished![/u][/b]🎊

Let's get straight into it, we've hit our biggest milestone yet! - After several years in development, [b]we're very pleased to confirm that Loco Motive is complete[/b]. We'll be continuing to squash any bugs in the lead up to launch, of course, but the work is done. We made an entire video-game, people!

We've had a few questions about whether we are still intending to release Loco Motive in Q4 2024.. 

[b]Yes! we'll be announcing our release date very soon, so please stay tuned for impending updates! [/b]


🎙️[b][u]Role Call! - Voice Cast Announced[/u][/b]🎙️

Earlier last month we gave the green light for our talented voice cast to announce their roles, and they delivered with gusto! Huge thanks to [b][url=https://x.com/KimlinhTran]Kimlinh Tran[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://x.com/soundswilde]Kirsty Gilmore[/url][/b] for casting! - we're proud to confirm (in Alphabetical order) that Loco Motive features the vocal talents of:

[url=https://x.com/jackayres71/status/1845865432277807371][b]Jack Ayres[/b][/url] as [b]Gunter Gudrun, Hagen Gudrun, Jimmy[/b]
[list]
[i]Jack is a Welsh actor and Voice Actor originally from Cardiff, South Wales. Jack has established himself as a versatile and rising voice actor for video games and character voices having featured in almost 40 video game titles as of 2024, including [b]Baldur’s Gate III[/b] and [b]Black Myth: Wukong[/b].[/i]
[/list]
[url=https://x.com/SamanthaBeart/status/1845856029583503503][b]Samantha Béart[/b][/url] as [b]April Benelli[/b]
[list]
[i]Samantha is a BAFTA and DICE nominated, GANG Award-winning actor. In the world of videogames, they are best known for their role as Karlach in [b]Baldur’s Gate III[/b], but you may also know them as Thomasina in the critically acclaimed adventure game “[b]The Excavation of Hob’s Barrow[/b]”.[/i]
[/list]
[url=https://x.com/sallybeaumont1/status/1845829537021468911][b]Sally Beaumont[/b][/url] as [b]Beverly Moore, Sister Gretchen, Quinn Morgan, Florence Schreiber, Pearl Wexler, Shelly Gedling [/b]
[list]
[i]Sally is a voice actor living in Oxford, UK and no stranger to voicing adventure game characters, having played a wide range across 30+ video game titles. This includes [b]The Excavation of Hob's Barrow[/b], a leading role as Fia in the upcoming [b]Old Skies[/b], and a stand out performance as Weeoo in [b]Harold Halibut[/b].[/i]
[/list]
[url=https://x.com/MisterABK/status/1846124364112015501][b]Alasdair Beckett-King[/b][/url] as [b]The Handshake Leader[/b]
[list]
[i]Alasdair is an author, actor, video game writer and award-winning stand-up comedian, winner of the 2017 Leicester Mercury Comedian of the Year, and Chortle's Breakthrough Comedian of the Year in 2023. Alasdair is also the creator of the Nelly Cootalot series of adventure games.[/i]
[/list]
[url=https://bsky.app/profile/sonicmega.bsky.social][b]Sean Chiplock[/b][/url] as [b]Arthur Ackerman[/b]
[list]
Sean has been an avid participant in videogame culture ever since his childhood, so it’s no surprise that he enjoys performing for them just as much as he enjoys playing them. In the world of videogames, Sean has featured in everything from AAA behemoths like [b]The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild[/b] and [b]Genshin Impact[/b] to indie success stories such as the recent [b]Duck Detective: The Secret Salami[/b].
[/list]
[url=https://x.com/Savy_VO/status/1845837546598600739][b]Savy Des-Etages[/b][/url] as [b]Diana Osterhagen[/b]
[list]
[i]Savy is an experienced voice actor and audiobook narrator hailing from Lancashire, UK. In the world of video games, Savy has lent her talents to widely popular titles such as [b]Viewfinder[/b], [b]Cassette Beasts[/b], [b]Fallout: London[/b] and more![/i]
[/list]

🌟[b][u]Next Fest Post-Mortem[/u][/b]🌟

The dust has finally settled on [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], and we couldn't be happier with the response to the demo! thank you to everyone who played, streamed on Twitch, told a friend and provided feedback! 

Loco Motive was in the top 50 titles under the '[i]Most Wishlisted Upcoming Games[/i]' tab, meaning we featured in the [b]top 1.41%[/b] of all games that participated!

We also did very well in our chosen categories, with Loco Motive featuring as the #1 game in the [i][b]Point-And-Click[/b][/i] and [i][b]Investigation[/b][/i] categories, and charting #2 in [i][b]Comedy[/b][/i], #3 in [i][b]Mystery[/b][/i] and #4 in the [i][b]Puzzle[/b][/i] categories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/208d81a068f176c74aa649059d50bf791edf1835.png[/img]

[b]We also received some kind words in the Press, of which we've curated a few quotes:[/b]

[list]
[*] [i]"If you're a LucasArts nut or just like a witty murder mystery, Loco Motive is a must play.... The set-up, characters, pixel art, slapstick humor, voice acting, animation – everything is fantastic."[/i] - [url=https://www.gamesradar.com/platforms/pc-gaming/here-are-the-10-steam-next-fest-demos-you-need-to-play-before-they-disappear/]GamesRadar+[/url]

[*] "[i]I really recommend checking out Loco Motive. When people say "LucasArts-style adventure" they normally wildly exaggerate. From this ENORMOUS demo, it might finally be time to bring out the accolade.[/i]" - [url=https://bsky.app/profile/botherer.bsky.social/post/3l6zd2lyu422w]John Walker, Co-Creator of Rock Paper Shotgun[/url]

[*] "[i]Loco Motive throws you headlong into a murder mystery worthy of an Agatha Christie novel but with the wit and slapstick of a classic cartoon...The exquisite animation, snappy soundtrack and soundscapes will have you engrossed[/i]." - [url=https://www.thumbculture.co.uk/steam-next-fest-october-2024-puzzles-police-work-pulsing-beats]Thumb Culture[/url]

[*] [i]Loco Motive is a throwback adventure game featuring rich characters, lovely sprite art, and plenty of comedy.[/i] - [url=https://www.pcmag.com/news/steam-next-fest-11-fun-game-demos-you-should-download-right-now]PC Mag[/url]
[/list]

🎖️[b][u]We're nominated in the DevGAMM Awards![/u][/b]🎖️

We're very excited and humbled to announce that Loco Motive has been nominated in three categories at the upcoming [url=https://devgamm.com/awards2024/]DevGAMM Awards 2024[/url] for: 

[b]🏆'EXCELLENCE IN NARRATIVE'
🏆'EXCELLENCE IN VISUAL ART'
🏆'THE GRAND PRIZE' [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/8fa8d6accee9652f2cc9de70779b114faaf6efc3.png[/img]

This was a very welcome surprise, and we'll be eagerly attending in Lisbon, Portugal next week with our fingers and toes crossed! 

✨[b][u]Wishlists![/u][/b]✨

We're delighted to announce that we're [i]very close[/i] to our dream goal of 100,000 wishlists by launch!

Another shout-out to everyone who added Loco Motive to your wishlists, shared feedback and has supported us throughout development. We're a tiny indie team creating our debut game and this means a lot to us! 

If you haven't already, consider wishlisting Loco Motive to receive a notification when the full game launches. It’s just one click, but it really helps us out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1709880/

Stay tuned for impending news, you can follow us for regular updates on [url=https://twitter.com/LocoMotiveGame]Twitter[/url] or join the official [url=https://discord.gg/QgZ3zdHu8C]Robust Games Discord[/url].

notes.title: Development Update #11
notes.content:
Hi there!

It’s been another busy few months for the Loco Motive team as we reach the end stages of development, but we're eager to bring you up to speed! 

[u]Voice Acting Complete![/u]

Another huge milestone has been reached, as we've now completed all of our recording sessions for the game. All 8000+ lines of dialogue have been implemented, and we're currently processing each line to ensure everything is of a consistent quality and volume level, etc.

We'll be holding off on any casting announcements just a little longer, but we could not be happier with the ensemble we've put together! The final roster features a whopping 23 talented voice artists, who'll be voicing our cast of 60+ characters!

[center][table][tr][td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/37e115ccef76b05757c3c291b800b367786953f4.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table][/center]

[u]Final Assets[/u]

Over the next few weeks, our priority is to get the remaining art and animation into the last chapter of the game, along with any remaining sound effects and music. It's been super satisfying to see that list get shorter every day. Once we reach the content complete stage, we'll be adding the final touches of polish and focusing on squashing any remaining bugs!

[u]Close-ups[/u]

One of the elements we've been working on adding periodically throughout the game are close-up shots, which will appear during dramatic moments or to add better context to the narrative. 

Close-ups begin as illustrated sketches by the wonderfully talented [url=https://x.com/lucydoesarts]Loukia Kyriakidou[/url], who also illustrated our key art and characters!

notes.title: Development Update #10
notes.content:
“Hallo Freunde!”

It’s been a busy few months for the Loco Motive team, but we're eager to bring you up to speed on our latest developments! Since our last update, we've been busy recording voice-over dialogue with our cast, forging [url=https://gog.prowly.com/306793-gog-climbs-aboard-the-loco-motive-hype-train-in-funding-partnership-with-robust-games-and-chucklefish]exciting new partnerships[/url], and approaching a significant milestone: Finalising all the text in the game!

The writing process involved plenty of typing, ruminating and head-scratching but after 70,000 words or so - I'm glad to say we're almost there. As we worked towards this milestone, it enabled us to better explore our options with localisation. 

The adventure game community is known for a strong and loyal German following, and Loco Motive has been no exception. With Germany featuring prominently as a top wishlist region, this was an easy decision for us to make:

✨[b]We're delighted to announce that Loco Motive will be launching with German language support![/b]✨

We’ve teamed up with [url=https://www.marcel-weyers.de/en/]Marcel Weyers[/url] to create the German localisation for Loco Motive, who you may be familiar with for their work on [i]Return To Monkey Island[/i], [i]Goodbye Volcano High[/i] & [i]Coffee Talk: Episode 2[/i]! 

Marcel was happy to share a few words about the project:

[quote=Marcel][i]“Working on Loco Motive has been super fun! There's so much attention to detail in this project, and even though some of the puns were quite tricky to translate, I can't wait for German adventure gamers to be able to play the game and laugh out loud as much as I did!”[/i][/quote]

notes.title: Development Update #9 - 2023 Recap!
notes.content:
Hello there! It's time for the last Loco Motive blog of the year, so let's get straight to it!

As I write this blog post, we’re winding down development here and preparing to spend some well earned time with our family over the Christmas holidays. It’s a time of reflection, so let’s look at all we’ve achieved, and what’s left to come for us in the new year!

🧭[b][u]2023 Recap[/u][/b]🧭

2023! It’s been a year of highlights, but let’s look at some of our biggest milestones:

[list]
[b][*] We demoed at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1709880?emclan=103582791471171695&emgid=3642885826023727745]PAX East [/url]and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1709880?emclan=103582791471171695&emgid=3731854112020421095]EGX 2023[/url] - the UK's biggest gaming exhibition!
[*] The game became [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1709880?emclan=103582791471171695&emgid=3672176343902474772]‘fully playable’ from start to finish[/url]
[*] Loco Motive was [url=https://indiecup.net/uk/nominees]nominated for a Critics’ Choice Award[/url]
[*] We were [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1709880?emclan=103582791471171695&emgid=6464396150020194870]officially selected to be part of LudoNarracon 2023[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1709880/view/3642885826042078597]We debuted our first playable demo on Steam[/url] as part of [b]Steam Mystery Fest[/b]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1709880?emclan=103582791471171695&emgid=3642885826023727745]Full controller support was added[/url] to the game!
[*] We reached [url=https://x.com/LocoMotiveGame/status/1702716831050473857?s=20]over 70,000+ Wishlists![/url][/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/1c3aa8ebdab3448bfdc5c727fa66d54a2ae1a338.jpg[/img]

[i][b]But that’s not all! We had time to squeeze in just a few more things before our Christmas break..[/b][/i]

🎤 [b][u]Voice Acting has begun![/u][/b]🎤 

Many of the questions we’ve received so far have revolved around voice, and if / when Loco Motive will feature voice acting.

I am pleased to confirm that we've recently begun recording dialogue with a professional voice cast, who we couldn’t be more excited about! These talented voice actors have featured in games such as [i]The Legend Of Zelda: Tears Of The Kingdom, Viewfinder, Genshin Impact, Baldur’s Gate III, Starfield[/i] and more!

[b]We’ll be announcing the full cast as we record more dialogue and get closer to launch, so keep your eyes peeled for a future announcement. Until then, we'll be keeping you guessing![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/cb2424a1d3614dd48ebe008d9d3589ede18c5c23.png[/img]

⚙️[b][u]Accessibility Options![/u][/b]⚙️

We wanted Loco Motive to be more accessible and give players more options. We recently spent some time adding accessibility features to the game, including the following:

[list]
[*] ⏪ Subtitle Speed Settings
[*] 🗨️ Subtitle Backing Settings
[*]  🗚  Bigger Text Size Settings
[*] 📛 Display Speaker Name Option
[*] 📑 Dyslexic Friendly Font Option
[*] 🎉 Confetti Mode! (Removes Blood!)
[*] 🎮 Playstation Controller Support!
[/list]

Here are some new screenshots to show some of these options in action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/bf9f31ae70639e119e1f50df28b451c9e720c50c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/477efbd7da2f46a565a9e443279500920f59c52e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/51320da653fe7fba83cf56cebf1d5157baeda20f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/13bfbd04ad9e40d7ae1860977d310c796614a410.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/32472f13ab41b0b4cb7817d761c06d9929680bd3.jpg[/img]

[b]This isn’t an exhaustive list, but we intend to listen to feedback and work to make the game as accessible as we can for launch![/b]

🛠️[b][u]Development continues![/u][/b]🛠️

Loco Motive became fully playable from start to finish in late July, and since then we've all been working dilligently to get more of the written dialogue into the game, adding more music and SFX, polishing the visuals and adding more animation! We've also been able to start exploring those bigger features like voice acting and localisation. 

We don't want to give too much away just yet, but we thought we could share some brand new animation work from the game for now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/ad152bce29d0bce8ec26cc79c185818172d8aa85.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/20d0090f1b5e9b7d1fd66c015d57acb3d1b03efe.gif[/img]

📅[b][u]Loco Motive launches in 2024[/u][/b]📅

As we mentioned earlier this year, [i]Loco Motive will now be launching in 2024[/i] for PC and Nintendo Switch.

There are a number of factors behind the decision, but ultimately we’re a small but ambitious team who needs a little bit of extra development time to deliver the game we set out to make. 

We can all agree that delays are annoying, but we strongly believe this extra time will allow Loco Motive to reach its full potential.

Thanks for your understanding and support. We can't wait to share the full Loco Motive adventure with you, it will be worth the wait!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/2fc379384bdac7f7b9cfd1d841c5d5885d7779c5.png[/img]

✨[b][u]Wishlists![/u][/b]✨

A massive shout-out to you all for adding Loco Motive to your wishlists! thanks to your efforts we recently hit our 70,000 wishlist milestone, and are already well on the way to our next goal! Thanks for all your support so far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/aeffca5325562b83efd0c7eea44b11e487aa33f9.png[/img]

We're excited to continue sharing updates with you as we make progress on the game. We’ll be sharing more progress as we go, but in the meantime, you can follow us for updates on [url=https://twitter.com/LocoMotiveGame]Twitter[/url] or join the official [url=https://discord.gg/QgZ3zdHu8C]Robust Games Discord[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1709880/Loco_Motive/

[i]Don’t forget to wishlist Loco Motive for a notification when the full game launches! It’s just one click, but it really helps us out. We also plan to use this data to decide future language support! [/i]


🙌[b][u]Teamwork makes the dream work![/u][/b]🙌

Before we break for Christmas, we just wanted to thank our entire extended team for their hard work in 2023, and for getting us one step closer to bringing the game to launch!

There's still a bit of work ahead of us, but 2024 will be the year of Loco Motive.

We couldn't be prouder of this team, and consider ourselves very lucky to have this level of talent involved.

[i]Have a Merry Christmas & Happy New Year![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/0bf9e8a0fd2cbe9bee728a6cf48cdc997796b4da.jpg[/img]

Adam & Joseph
[i]Robust Games[/i]

notes.title: Development Update #7
notes.content:
Hello! It's time for the latest scoop on Loco Motive's development!

The past few months on Loco Motive have been a whirlwind as we steer towards the finish line. Let's dive into everything that's gone on since our last update.

🚂 [u][b]Major Milestone Reached: Full Playability[/b][/u] 🚂

July kicked off with us reaching a major milestone: Loco Motive is now fully playable from start to finish. That's a big deal for our team! The next stretch will focus on getting the dialogue locked, getting the visuals polished, and exploring big features like voice recording and localisation. 

We can share more information on that in another update, but for now here's a sneak peek at a new, mysterious location from the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/ce9700e3cc7fc7d9e807e051ab664775b0405813.png[/img]

🪞[b][u]Something to reflect on![/u][/b]🪞

We recently implemented another neat visual feature to the game - working mirrors! but that's not all, this amazing tech allows us to add things like shiny floors, wet reflective surfaces and more!

[previewyoutube=6YKait5qp58;full][/previewyoutube]

🏆 [u][b]Critics' Choice Award[/b][/u]🏆

Back in June, Loco Motive was nominated for the [url=https://indiecup.net/uk/nominees]Indie Cup Critic's Choice Award [/url], with each nominee selected by a panel of critics, games journalists and streamers - including [i]Rock Paper Shotgun, Edge, GamesRadar, TheGamer[/i] & More.

We didn't clinch the win in our category, but hey, being nominated was a win in itself! Big thanks to the jury for their feedback. Reading their positive comments gave us a real boost and made us feel like we're on the right track!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/249b8b6eb16062d57413a46fc2fa4053d2a8514e.png[/img]

🌟 [b][u]Racing towards 70k Wishlists![/u][/b] 🌟

Since our last wishlist check-in, we're now only a few hundred away from receiving 70,000 wishlists!

A massive shout-out to you all for adding Loco Motive to your wishlists. It's not just a number—it lets Steam know there's interest and excitement around the game, plus, you'll be one of the first to be notified via email when the game launches! If you haven't wishlisted already, what are you waiting for? Let's make it happen!

We're excited to continue sharing updates with you as we make progress on the game, but that’s all for now! We’ll be sharing more progress as we go, but in the meantime, you can follow us for updates on [url=https://twitter.com/LocoMotiveGame]Twitter[/url] or join the official [url=https://discord.gg/QgZ3zdHu8C]Robust Games Discord[/url].

notes.title: Development Update #6
notes.content:
It's time for another development blog post! 

Loco Motive has had an exciting year so far, with us recently showcasing the demo both on Steam and at this year's [b]PAX East [/b]in Boston. The game received a lot of positive feedback from the public and the press, and we're thrilled to share that [url=https://hardcoregamer.com/]Hardcore Gamer[/url] named Loco Motive one of their [url=https://hardcoregamer.com/pax/the-top-ten-games-of-pax-east-2023/439244/]Top Ten Games of PAX East 2023[/url]!

"[i]Developers Robust Games made quite the impression thanks to a perfectly-cartoonish style, an intriguing setting, a great sense of humor and well-done puzzles that should hopefully challenge players even more in the final product. It all looks like another possible gem for the genre, and should be one train ride worth taking.[/i]" 

We couldn't agree more! We're grateful for the recognition and are committed to continuing to deliver a game that meets the expectations of our fans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/1bb4c639b6fe9e2f2cc9a9e1ca1c87c9b07238eb.png[/img]

In the meantime, we've been working hard on the next large piece of the game, where players take control of Herman Merman. These events take place a little earlier in the evening, so we change up the lighting to reflect this. The brilliant sunset acts as a stark contrast to the stormy weather players will experience in the first section of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/c6c8ad464cdd744feb4c0112ea8138a8a3c17340.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/b0a8c98c9ae2b1426a310bba201e76826dedf971.png[/img]

One of the most exciting recent additions to the game is controller support. While the game uses a traditional point & click interface, we know that many players prefer to play games with a gamepad, and we want to make sure Loco Motive is as accessible as possible. Now the game plays great with both!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650287/42fadd0131404ca3e27870eb122f193eb9a650d4.png[/img]

We're excited to continue sharing updates with you as we make progress on the game, but that’s all for now! We’ll be sharing more progress as we go, but in the meantime, you can follow us for updates on [url=https://twitter.com/LocoMotiveGame]Twitter[/url] or join the official [url=https://discord.gg/QgZ3zdHu8C]Robust Games Discord[/url].
